+     8	 * Options:
+     9	 *   --dist <path>            Path to dist directory (default: ./dist)
+    10	 *   --component <name>       Component instance name (default: staticHosting)
+    11	 *   --prod                   Deploy to production deployment
+    12	 *   --build                  Run the frontend build before uploading
+    13	 *   --build-command <cmd>    Override the frontend build command
+    14	 *   --spa / --no-spa         Enable or disable SPA fallback
+    15	 *   --cdn                    Use the legacy convex-fs integration
+    16	 *   --cdn-delete-function    App function that deletes old CDN blobs
+    17	 *   --concurrency <n>        Parallel upload workers (default: 5)
+    18	 *   --help                   Show help
+    19	 */
+    20	import { readFileSync, readdirSync, existsSync } from "fs";
+    21	import { join, relative, extname, resolve } from "path";
+    22	import { randomUUID } from "crypto";
+    23	import { runConvexAsync, spawnShell } from "./commands.js";
+    24	import { chunkBySerializedArgument, MAX_CONVEX_ARGUMENT_BYTES, } from "./argumentChunks.js";
+    25	import { parseUploadArgs } from "./args.js";
+    26	import { componentNameCandidates, isLegacyAutoDetected, legacyComponentNameWarning, } from "./componentName.js";
+    27	// MIME type mapping
+    28	const MIME_TYPES = {
+    29	    ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
+    30	    ".js": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
+    31	    ".mjs": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8",
+    32	    ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
+    33	    ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
+    34	    ".png": "image/png",
+    35	    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    36	    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    37	    ".gif": "image/gif",
+    38	    ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
+    39	    ".ico": "image/x-icon",
+    40	    ".webp": "image/webp",
+    41	    ".woff": "font/woff",
+    42	    ".woff2": "font/woff2",
+    43	    ".ttf": "font/ttf",
+    44	    ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
+    45	    ".map": "application/json",
+    46	    ".webmanifest": "application/manifest+json",
+    47	    ".xml": "application/xml",
+    48	};
+    49	function getMimeType(path) {
+    50	    return MIME_TYPES[extname(path).toLowerCase()] || "application/octet-stream";
+    51	}
+    52	function showHelp() {
+    53	    console.log(`
+    54	Usage: npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload [options]
+    55	
+    56	Upload static files from a dist directory to Convex storage.
+    57	
+    58	Options:
+    59	  -d, --dist <path>           Path to dist directory (default: ./dist)
+    60	  -c, --component <name>      Static-hosting component instance name (default: staticHosting)
+    61	      --prod                  Deploy to production deployment
+    62	  -b, --build                 Run the build command with VITE_CONVEX_URL +
+    63	                              STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH set before uploading
+    64	      --build-command <cmd>   Build command to run (default: 'npm run build').
+    65	                              Implies --build.
+    66	      --no-spa                Disable SPA fallback for this deployment (return a
+    67	                              404 instead of falling back to /index.html)
+    68	      --spa                   Enable SPA fallback for this deployment (default)
+    69	      --cdn                   Use the legacy convex-fs integration
+    70	      --cdn-delete-function <name>  Legacy app function that deletes CDN blobs
+    71	  -j, --concurrency <n>       Number of parallel uploads (default: 5)
+    72	  -h, --help                  Show this help message
+    73	
+    74	Examples:
+    75	  # Upload to Convex storage
+    76	  npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload
+    77	  npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload --dist ./build --prod
+    78	  npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload --build --prod
+    79	
+    80	  # Upload through an existing legacy convex-fs integration
+    81	  npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload --cdn --prod
+    82	`);
+    83	}
+    84	// Global flag for production mode
+    85	let useProd = true;
+    86	const MAX_ASSETS_PER_DEPLOYMENT = 1800;
+    87	const MAX_MANIFEST_SERIALIZED_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
+    88	// A Convex CLI function result can be truncated around 64 KiB. Signed upload
+    89	// URLs are long enough that 250 sometimes crosses that boundary.
+    90	const UPLOAD_URL_BATCH_SIZE = 100;
+    91	const MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE = 256;
+    92	const MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES = 20;
+    93	/**
+    94	 * Resolve the component's deployment URLs and the instance name that answered.
+    95	 *
+    96	 * When the caller relied on the default name we also probe the legacy 0.1.x
+    97	 * name so a same-name migration keeps working without `--component selfHosting`
+    98	 * on every command; landing on the legacy name prints a one-time warning. Bails
+    99	 * the CLI if no candidate is deployed. Uploading wouldn't work either, so a
+   100	 * fallback would only hide the real problem.
+   101	 */
+   102	async function fetchUrls(requested) {
+   103	    const candidates = componentNameCandidates(requested);
+   104	    for (const name of candidates) {
+   105	        try {
+   106	            const out = await convexRunAsync(name, "lib:getUrls", {}, { quiet: true });
+   107	            const urls = JSON.parse(out);
+   108	            if (isLegacyAutoDetected(requested, name)) {
+   109	                console.warn(legacyComponentNameWarning(name));
+   110	            }
+   111	            return { urls, componentName: name };
+   112	        }
+   113	        catch {
+   114	            // Try the next candidate name.
+   115	        }
+   116	    }
+   117	    console.error(`Could not reach component ${candidates
+   118	        .map((name) => `"${name}"`)
+   119	        .join(" or ")}. Deploy the Convex backend first and ensure --component ` +
+   120	        `matches the name in convex.config.ts.`);
+   121	    process.exit(1);
+   122	}
+   123	function convexRunAsync(componentName, functionPath, args = {}, options = {}) {
+   124	    const serializedArgs = JSON.stringify(args);
+   125	    const argumentBytes = Buffer.byteLength(serializedArgs);
+   126	    if (argumentBytes > MAX_CONVEX_ARGUMENT_BYTES) {
+   127	        throw new Error("The Convex function argument is " +
+   128	            argumentBytes +
+   129	            " bytes, which exceeds the portable command-line limit. " +
+   130	            "This is an internal chunking error; please report it.");
+   131	    }
+   132	    return runConvexAsync([
+   133	        "run",
+   134	        ...(componentName ? ["--component", componentName] : []),
+   135	        functionPath,
+   136	        serializedArgs,
+   137	        "--typecheck=disable",
+   138	        "--codegen=disable",
+   139	        ...(useProd ? ["--prod"] : []),
+   140	    ], options);
+   141	}
+   142	function errorMessage(error) {
+   143	    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+   144	}
+   145	async function cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   146	    if (!cdnDeleteFunction)
+   147	        return 0;
+   148	    let cleaned = 0;
+   149	    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+   150	        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:listPendingBlobCleanup", { limit: 250 });
+   151	        const blobIds = JSON.parse(output);
+   152	        if (!Array.isArray(blobIds) ||
+   153	            !blobIds.every((blobId) => typeof blobId === "string")) {
+   154	            throw new Error("Component returned invalid pending CDN cleanup data");
+   155	        }
+   156	        if (blobIds.length === 0)
+   157	            return cleaned;
+   158	        const deleteChunks = chunkBySerializedArgument(blobIds, (chunk) => ({
+   159	            blobIds: chunk,
+   160	        }));
+   161	        for (const chunk of deleteChunks) {
+   162	            await convexRunAsync(undefined, cdnDeleteFunction, { blobIds: chunk });
+   163	            await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:acknowledgeBlobCleanup", {
+   164	                blobIds: chunk,
+   165	            });
+   166	            cleaned += chunk.length;
+   167	        }
+   168	    }
+   169	    console.warn("Warning: CDN cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+   170	    return cleaned;
+   171	}
+   172	async function cleanUpAbandonedUploads(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   173	    let discarded = 0;
+   174	    let deletedFiles = 0;
+   175	    let queuedBlobIds = 0;
+   176	    try {
+   177	        let stagingDrained = false;
+   178	        for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+   179	            const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:cleanupAbandonedStaging", { limit: MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE });
+   180	            const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   181	            if (typeof result.discarded !== "number" ||
+   182	                typeof result.deletedFiles !== "number" ||
+   183	                typeof result.queuedBlobIds !== "number") {
+   184	                throw new Error("Component returned invalid staging cleanup data");
+   185	            }
+   186	            discarded += result.discarded;
+   187	            deletedFiles += result.deletedFiles;
+   188	            queuedBlobIds += result.queuedBlobIds;
+   189	            if (result.discarded < MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE) {
+   190	                stagingDrained = true;
+   191	                break;
+   192	            }
+   193	        }
+   194	        if (!stagingDrained) {
+   195	            console.warn("Warning: Staging cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+   196	        }
+   197	        deletedFiles += await cleanUpPendingStorage(componentName);
+   198	        deletedFiles += await cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, undefined, "desc");
+   199	        deletedFiles += await cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, undefined, "asc");
+   200	        if (discarded > 0 || deletedFiles > 0 || queuedBlobIds > 0) {
+   201	            console.log(`Recovered ${discarded} abandoned manifest record(s), removed ${deletedFiles} old unreferenced file(s), and queued ${queuedBlobIds} CDN blob(s) for cleanup.`);
+   202	        }
+   203	        if (cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   204	            const cleaned = await cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction);
+   205	            if (cleaned > 0) {
+   206	                console.log(`Cleaned up ${cleaned} pending CDN blob(s).`);
+   207	            }
+   208	        }
+   209	    }
+   210	    catch (cleanupError) {
+   211	        console.warn("Warning: Could not finish abandoned-upload maintenance: " +
+   212	            errorMessage(cleanupError));
+   213	    }
+   214	}
+   215	async function cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, before, order = "asc") {
+   216	    let deleted = 0;
+   217	    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+   218	        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:cleanupUnreferencedStorage", {
+   219	            limit: MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE,
+   220	            order,
+   221	            ...(before === undefined ? {} : { before }),
+   222	        });
+   223	        const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   224	        if (typeof result.deleted !== "number" ||
+   225	            typeof result.needsAnotherPass !== "boolean") {
+   226	            throw new Error("Component returned invalid storage cleanup data");
+   227	        }
+   228	        deleted += result.deleted;
+   229	        if (!result.needsAnotherPass)
+   230	            return deleted;
+   231	    }
+   232	    console.warn("Warning: Orphan storage cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+   233	    return deleted;
+   234	}
+   235	async function cleanUpPendingStorage(componentName) {
+   236	    let deleted = 0;
+   237	    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+   238	        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:cleanupPendingStorage", { limit: MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE });
+   239	        const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   240	        if (typeof result.deleted !== "number" ||
+   241	            typeof result.needsAnotherPass !== "boolean") {
+   242	            throw new Error("Component returned invalid pending-storage cleanup data");
+   243	        }
+   244	        deleted += result.deleted;
+   245	        if (!result.needsAnotherPass)
+   246	            return deleted;
+   247	    }
+   248	    console.warn("Warning: Published storage cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+   249	    return deleted;
+   250	}
+   251	async function forEachWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, worker) {
+   252	    let nextIndex = 0;
+   253	    let firstError;
+   254	    async function runWorker() {
+   255	        while (firstError === undefined) {
+   256	            const index = nextIndex++;
+   257	            if (index >= items.length)
+   258	                return;
+   259	            try {
+   260	                await worker(items[index], index);
+   261	            }
+   262	            catch (error) {
+   263	                firstError ??= error;
+   264	            }
+   265	        }
+   266	    }
+   267	    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, items.length);
+   268	    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workerCount }, () => runWorker()));
+   269	    if (firstError !== undefined)
+   270	        throw firstError;
+   271	}
+   272	async function cleanUpFailedUpload(componentName, deploymentId, uploaded, cdnDeleteFunction, publishAttempted) {
+   273	    let discardSucceeded = false;
+   274	    let discarded = 0;
+   275	    try {
+   276	        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:discardStagedDeployment", { deploymentId });
+   277	        const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   278	        if (typeof result.discarded !== "number") {
+   279	            throw new Error("Component returned an invalid discard result");
+   280	        }
+   281	        discardSucceeded = true;
+   282	        discarded = result.discarded;
+   283	    }
+   284	    catch (cleanupError) {
+   285	        console.warn("Warning: Could not discard the staged manifest: " +
+   286	            errorMessage(cleanupError));
+   287	    }
+   288	    // Convex mutations have a single transaction order. If discard succeeds,
+   289	    // either it removed the staged rows before a late publish could use them, or
+   290	    // publish already committed and removed them first. In the latter case the
+   291	    // component cleanup below sees the live references and keeps those files.
+   292	    const canCleanComponentFiles = !publishAttempted || discardSucceeded;
+   293	    if (uploaded.storageIds.length > 0 && canCleanComponentFiles) {
+   294	        try {
+   295	            let deleted = 0;
+   296	            let stillReferenced = 0;
+   297	            const chunks = chunkBySerializedArgument(uploaded.storageIds, (storageIds) => ({ storageIds }));
+   298	            for (const storageIds of chunks) {
+   299	                const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:deleteUploadedFiles", { storageIds });
+   300	                const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   301	                if (typeof result.deleted === "number")
+   302	                    deleted += result.deleted;
+   303	                if (typeof result.stillReferenced === "number") {
+   304	                    stillReferenced += result.stillReferenced;
+   305	                }
+   306	            }
+   307	            console.log(`Removed ${deleted} file(s) from the failed upload.`);
+   308	            if (stillReferenced > 0) {
+   309	                console.warn(`Kept ${stillReferenced} file(s) because the live deployment references them. The publish may have completed even though its response was lost.`);
+   310	            }
+   311	        }
+   312	        catch (cleanupError) {
+   313	            console.warn("Warning: Could not remove component files from the failed upload: " +
+   314	                errorMessage(cleanupError));
+   315	        }
+   316	    }
+   317	    else if (uploaded.storageIds.length > 0) {
+   318	        console.warn(`${uploaded.storageIds.length} component file(s) were left in place because the CLI could not cancel or confirm the publish.`);
+   319	    }
+   320	    // The app-level CDN delete function cannot inspect component-private live
+   321	    // references. Only delete CDN blobs when no publish was attempted, or when
+   322	    // discard removed staged rows and therefore won the transaction race.
+   323	    const canDeleteCdnBlobs = !publishAttempted || (discardSucceeded && discarded > 0);
+   324	    if (uploaded.blobIds.length > 0 && canDeleteCdnBlobs) {
+   325	        try {
+   326	            // Record these IDs before calling app-owned deletion. If that call fails
+   327	            // or only partially completes, the next upload can retry safely.
+   328	            const chunks = chunkBySerializedArgument(uploaded.blobIds, (blobIds) => ({
+   329	                blobIds,
+   330	            }));
+   331	            for (const blobIds of chunks) {
+   332	                await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:queueBlobCleanup", {
+   333	                    blobIds,
+   334	                });
+   335	            }
+   336	            if (cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   337	                const cleaned = await cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction);
+   338	                console.log(`Removed ${cleaned} pending CDN blob(s).`);
+   339	            }
+   340	            else {
+   341	                console.warn(`${uploaded.blobIds.length} CDN blob(s) from the failed upload were queued for cleanup. Pass --cdn-delete-function on a later upload to delete them.`);
+   342	            }
+   343	        }
+   344	        catch (cleanupError) {
+   345	            console.warn("Warning: Could not finish queuing or deleting CDN blobs from the failed upload: " +
+   346	                errorMessage(cleanupError));
+   347	        }
+   348	    }
+   349	    else if (uploaded.blobIds.length > 0 && !canDeleteCdnBlobs) {
+   350	        console.warn(`${uploaded.blobIds.length} CDN blob(s) were left in place because the CLI could not determine whether the publish completed.`);
+   351	    }
+   352	}
+   353	async function uploadWithConcurrency(files, componentName, deploymentId, useCdn, cdnUploadBase, concurrency, spaFallback, cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   354	    const total = files.length;
+   355	    const uploaded = { storageIds: [], blobIds: [] };
+   356	    // Separate CDN and storage files
+   357	    const cdnFiles = [];
+   358	    const storageFiles = [];
+   359	    for (const file of files) {
+   360	        const isHtml = file.contentType.startsWith("text/html");
+   361	        if (useCdn && !isHtml && cdnUploadBase) {
+   362	            cdnFiles.push(file);
+   363	        }
+   364	        else {
+   365	            storageFiles.push(file);
+   366	        }
+   367	    }
+   368	    // Upload storage files using batch operations
+   369	    let completed = 0;
+   370	    const allAssets = [];
+   371	    let publishAttempted = false;
+   372	    try {
+   373	        if (storageFiles.length > 0) {
+   374	            // Keep both the Convex array value and the child-process stdout buffer
+   375	            // bounded, even for a deployment with thousands of files.
+   376	            console.log(`  Generating ${storageFiles.length} upload URLs...`);
+   377	            const uploadUrls = [];
+   378	            for (let offset = 0; offset < storageFiles.length; offset += UPLOAD_URL_BATCH_SIZE) {
+   379	                const count = Math.min(UPLOAD_URL_BATCH_SIZE, storageFiles.length - offset);
+   380	                const urlsOutput = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:generateUploadUrls", { count });
+   381	                const batch = JSON.parse(urlsOutput);
+   382	                if (!Array.isArray(batch) ||
+   383	                    batch.length !== count ||
+   384	                    !batch.every((url) => typeof url === "string")) {
+   385	                    throw new Error("Component returned invalid upload URLs");
+   386	                }
+   387	                uploadUrls.push(...batch);
+   388	            }
+   389	            // Step 2: Upload all files in parallel via fetch
+   390	            const storageIds = new Array(storageFiles.length);
+   391	            await forEachWithConcurrency(storageFiles, concurrency, async (file, idx) => {
+   392	                const content = readFileSync(file.localPath);
+   393	                const response = await fetch(uploadUrls[idx], {
+   394	                    method: "POST",
+   395	                    headers: { "Content-Type": file.contentType },
+   396	                    body: content,
+   397	                });
+   398	                if (!response.ok) {
+   399	                    throw new Error("Storage upload failed for " +
+   400	                        file.path +
+   401	                        ": " +
+   402	                        response.status +
+   403	                        " " +
+   404	                        response.statusText);
+   405	                }
+   406	                const { storageId } = (await response.json());
+   407	                if (typeof storageId !== "string") {
+   408	                    throw new Error("Storage upload returned no storageId for " + file.path);
+   409	                }
+   410	                storageIds[idx] = storageId;
+   411	                uploaded.storageIds.push(storageId);
+   412	                completed++;
+   413	                const isHtml = file.contentType.startsWith("text/html");
+   414	                console.log(`  [${completed}/${total}] ${file.path} (${isHtml ? "storage/html" : "storage"})`);
+   415	            });
+   416	            for (let i = 0; i < storageFiles.length; i++) {
+   417	                allAssets.push({
+   418	                    path: storageFiles[i].path,
+   419	                    storageId: storageIds[i],
+   420	                    contentType: storageFiles[i].contentType,
+   421	                    deploymentId,
+   422	                });
+   423	            }
+   424	        }
+   425	        // Upload CDN files (still uses per-file calls since CDN has its own upload endpoint)
+   426	        if (cdnFiles.length > 0 && cdnUploadBase) {
+   427	            await forEachWithConcurrency(cdnFiles, concurrency, async (file) => {
+   428	                const content = readFileSync(file.localPath);
+   429	                const uploadResponse = await fetch(`${cdnUploadBase}/fs/upload`, {
+   430	                    method: "POST",
+   431	                    headers: { "Content-Type": file.contentType },
+   432	                    body: content,
+   433	                });
+   434	                if (!uploadResponse.ok) {
+   435	                    throw new Error(`CDN upload failed for ${file.path}: ${uploadResponse.status}`);
+   436	                }
+   437	                const { blobId } = (await uploadResponse.json());
+   438	                if (typeof blobId !== "string") {
+   439	                    throw new Error("CDN upload returned no blobId for " + file.path);
+   440	                }
+   441	                uploaded.blobIds.push(blobId);
+   442	                allAssets.push({
+   443	                    path: file.path,
+   444	                    blobId,
+   445	                    contentType: file.contentType,
+   446	                    deploymentId,
+   447	                });
+   448	                completed++;
+   449	                console.log(`  [${completed}/${total}] ${file.path} (cdn)`);
+   450	            });
+   451	        }
+   452	        // Stage the manifest in portable command-line chunks. These rows are not
+   453	        // served, so the previous deployment stays intact until publish succeeds.
+   454	        const manifestChunks = chunkBySerializedArgument(allAssets, (assets) => ({
+   455	            assets,
+   456	        }));
+   457	        for (let index = 0; index < manifestChunks.length; index++) {
+   458	            console.log(`  Staging manifest chunk ${index + 1}/${manifestChunks.length}...`);
+   459	            await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:stageAssets", {
+   460	                assets: manifestChunks[index],
+   461	            });
+   462	        }
+   463	        // Publish the staged manifest, SPA setting, and old-asset GC in one
+   464	        // mutation. The previous deployment stays intact if this call fails.
+   465	        console.log("  Publishing deployment...");
+   466	        publishAttempted = true;
+   467	        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:publishDeployment", {
+   468	            currentDeploymentId: deploymentId,
+   469	            expectedAssetCount: allAssets.length,
+   470	            spaFallback,
+   471	        });
+   472	        const result = JSON.parse(output);
+   473	        if (typeof result.deleted !== "number" ||
+   474	            typeof result.pendingBlobCleanup !== "number") {
+   475	            throw new Error("Component returned an invalid publish result");
+   476	        }
+   477	        return {
+   478	            deleted: result.deleted,
+   479	            pendingBlobCleanup: result.pendingBlobCleanup,
+   480	        };
+   481	    }
+   482	    catch (error) {
+   483	        if (publishAttempted) {
+   484	            try {
+   485	                const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:getCurrentDeployment");
+   486	                const current = JSON.parse(output);
+   487	                if (current?.currentDeploymentId === deploymentId) {
+   488	                    console.warn("The publish completed, but the CLI could not read a valid response. The new deployment is live and its files were kept.");
+   489	                    return {
+   490	                        deleted: 0,
+   491	                        pendingBlobCleanup: typeof current.pendingBlobCleanupCount === "number"
+   492	                            ? current.pendingBlobCleanupCount
+   493	                            : 0,
+   494	                    };
+   495	                }
+   496	            }
+   497	            catch (reconcileError) {
+   498	                console.warn("Warning: Could not determine whether the publish completed: " +
+   499	                    errorMessage(reconcileError));
+   500	            }
+   501	        }
+   502	        await cleanUpFailedUpload(componentName, deploymentId, uploaded, cdnDeleteFunction, publishAttempted);
+   503	        throw error;
+   504	    }
+   505	}
+   506	function collectFiles(dir, baseDir) {
+   507	    const files = [];
+   508	    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+   509	        const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name);
+   510	        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
+   511	            files.push(...collectFiles(fullPath, baseDir));
+   512	        }
+   513	        else if (entry.isFile()) {
+   514	            files.push({
+   515	                path: "/" + relative(baseDir, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, "/"),
+   516	                localPath: fullPath,
+   517	                contentType: getMimeType(fullPath),
+   518	            });
+   519	        }
+   520	    }
+   521	    return files;
+   522	}
+   523	function estimateManifestBytes(files, deploymentId) {
+   524	    // IDs returned by Convex storage and convex-fs are much shorter than this.
+   525	    // The generous placeholder lets us reject oversized path metadata before
+   526	    // uploading while the component still enforces the exact serialized size.
+   527	    const locationPlaceholder = "x".repeat(128);
+   528	    return Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(files.map((file) => ({
+   529	        path: file.path,
+   530	        storageId: locationPlaceholder,
+   531	        contentType: file.contentType,
+   532	        deploymentId,
+   533	    }))));
+   534	}
+   535	async function main() {
+   536	    const args = parseUploadArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
+   537	    if (args.help) {
+   538	        showHelp();
+   539	        process.exit(0);
+   540	    }
+   541	    // Set global prod flag
+   542	    useProd = args.prod;
+   543	    // The component knows both its CONVEX_SITE_URL (where the app is served,
+   544	    // including the mount prefix) and CONVEX_CLOUD_URL (what the frontend
+   545	    // connects to). We fetch both in one call and trust neither hostname. This
+   546	    // also resolves the instance name actually mounted (default or legacy).
+   547	    const { urls: { siteUrl: componentSiteUrl, cloudUrl: convexUrl }, componentName: resolvedComponentName, } = await fetchUrls(args.component);
+   548	    // Run build if requested
+   549	    if (args.build) {
+   550	        const basePath = new URL(componentSiteUrl).pathname || "/";
+   551	        const envLabel = useProd ? "production" : "development";
+   552	        console.log(`🔨 Building for ${envLabel}...`);
+   553	        console.log(`   Build command: ${args.buildCommand}`);
+   554	        console.log(`   VITE_CONVEX_URL=${convexUrl}`);
+   555	        console.log(`   STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH=${basePath}`);
+   556	        console.log("");
+   557	        const buildResult = spawnShell(args.buildCommand, {
+   558	            ...process.env,
+   559	            VITE_CONVEX_URL: convexUrl,
+   560	            STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH: basePath,
+   561	        });
+   562	        if (buildResult !== 0) {
+   563	            console.error("Build failed.");
+   564	            process.exit(1);
+   565	        }
+   566	        console.log("");
+   567	    }
+   568	    const distDir = resolve(args.dist);
+   569	    const componentName = resolvedComponentName;
+   570	    const useCdn = args.cdn;
+   571	    // Convex storage deployment
+   572	    if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
+   573	        console.error(`Error: dist directory not found: ${distDir}`);
+   574	        console.error("Run your build command first (e.g., 'npm run build' or add --build flag)");
+   575	        process.exit(1);
+   576	    }
+   577	    // /fs/upload lives at the deployment root, not under the component's
+   578	    // mount prefix.
+   579	    const cdnUploadBase = useCdn ? new URL(componentSiteUrl).origin : null;
+   580	    const deploymentId = randomUUID();
+   581	    const files = collectFiles(distDir, distDir);
+   582	    if (files.length === 0) {
+   583	        console.error(`Error: dist directory is empty: ${distDir}`);
+   584	        console.error("Refusing to replace the live deployment with no files.");
+   585	        process.exit(1);
+   586	    }
+   587	    if (!files.some((file) => file.path === "/index.html")) {
+   588	        console.error(`Error: dist directory has no index.html: ${distDir}`);
+   589	        console.error("Refusing to publish a static site without its entry point.");
+   590	        process.exit(1);
+   591	    }
+   592	    if (files.length > MAX_ASSETS_PER_DEPLOYMENT) {
+   593	        console.error(`Error: dist directory contains ${files.length} files; the supported maximum is ${MAX_ASSETS_PER_DEPLOYMENT}.`);
+   594	        console.error("Reduce the number of emitted files so publication stays within Convex transaction limits.");
+   595	        process.exit(1);
+   596	    }
+   597	    const estimatedManifestBytes = estimateManifestBytes(files, deploymentId);
+   598	    if (estimatedManifestBytes > MAX_MANIFEST_SERIALIZED_BYTES) {
+   599	        console.error(`Error: asset manifest metadata is approximately ${estimatedManifestBytes} bytes; the supported maximum is ${MAX_MANIFEST_SERIALIZED_BYTES}.`);
+   600	        console.error("Shorten emitted asset paths or reduce the number of files so publication stays within Convex transaction byte limits.");
+   601	        process.exit(1);
+   602	    }
+   603	    await cleanUpAbandonedUploads(componentName, args.cdnDeleteFunction);
+   604	    const envLabel = useProd ? "production" : "development";
+   605	    console.log(`🚀 Deploying to ${envLabel} environment`);
+   606	    if (useCdn) {
+   607	        console.log("☁️  CDN mode: non-HTML assets will be uploaded to convex-fs");
+   608	    }
+   609	    console.log("🔒 Using secure internal functions (requires Convex CLI auth)");
+   610	    console.log(`Uploading ${files.length} files with deployment ID: ${deploymentId}`);
+   611	    console.log(`Component: ${componentName}`);
+   612	    console.log("");
+   613	    const publishResult = await uploadWithConcurrency(files, componentName, deploymentId, useCdn, cdnUploadBase, args.concurrency, args.spaFallback, args.cdnDeleteFunction);
+   614	    console.log("");
+   615	    let deletedCount = publishResult.deleted;
+   616	    try {
+   617	        // Publish queues only IDs from the old live manifest. Deleting that queue
+   618	        // cannot race with files from another uploader that are not staged yet.
+   619	        deletedCount += await cleanUpPendingStorage(componentName);
+   620	    }
+   621	    catch (cleanupError) {
+   622	        console.warn("Warning: The new deployment is live, but old component storage could not be fully removed: " +
+   623	            errorMessage(cleanupError));
+   624	    }
+   625	    if (deletedCount > 0) {
+   626	        console.log(`Cleaned up ${deletedCount} old storage file(s) from previous deployments`);
+   627	    }
+   628	    // Old CDN IDs are persisted by the component until the app-level delete
+   629	    // function succeeds, including when the publish response was lost.
+   630	    if (args.cdnDeleteFunction) {
+   631	        try {
+   632	            const cleaned = await cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, args.cdnDeleteFunction);
+   633	            if (cleaned > 0) {
+   634	                console.log(`Cleaned up ${cleaned} old CDN blob(s) from previous deployments`);
+   635	            }
+   636	        }
+   637	        catch (error) {
+   638	            console.warn("Warning: Could not delete old CDN blobs via " +
+   639	                args.cdnDeleteFunction +
+   640	                ": " +
+   641	                errorMessage(error));
+   642	        }
+   643	    }
+   644	    else if (publishResult.pendingBlobCleanup > 0) {
+   645	        console.log(`${publishResult.pendingBlobCleanup} CDN blob(s) are pending cleanup. Pass --cdn-delete-function to delete them.`);
+   646	    }
+   647	    console.log("");
+   648	    console.log("✨ Upload complete!");
+   649	    console.log("");
+   650	    console.log(`Your app is now available at: ${componentSiteUrl}`);
+   651	}
+   652	main().catch((error) => {
+   653	    console.error("Upload failed:", error);
+   654	    process.exit(1);
+   655	});
+   656	//# sourceMappingURL=upload.js.map
+     1	// @vitest-environment node
+     2	import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+     3	import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
+     4	import { parse } from "yaml";
+     5	
+     6	type Step = { id?: string; name?: string; if?: string; run?: string; uses?: string; with?: Record<string, unknown>; env?: Record<string, string> };
+     7	type Job = { env?: Record<string, string>; steps: Step[] };
+     8	type Workflow = {
+     9	  on: unknown;
+    10	  env?: Record<string, string>;
+    11	  permissions: unknown;
+    12	  concurrency: { group: string; "cancel-in-progress": boolean };
+    13	  jobs: Record<string, Job>;
+    14	};
+    15	
+    16	const deployments = [
+    17	  { name: "sandbox", file: "deploy-sandbox.yml", branch: "spec/core-loop", secret: "CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY_SANDBOX" },
+    18	  { name: "production", file: "deploy-production.yml", branch: "main", secret: "CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY_PRODUCTION" },
+    19	];
+    20	
+    21	describe.each(deployments)("deploying the $name deployment", ({ name, file, branch, secret }) => {
+    22	  const workflow = parse(readFileSync(new URL(`./${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Workflow;
+    23	  const steps = Object.values(workflow.jobs).flatMap((job) => job.steps);
+    24	  const deployStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("convex deploy"));
+    25	  const uploadStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("static-hosting upload"));
+    26	  const prepareStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("website/flag:prepareWebsiteFlag"));
+    27	  const keyedSteps = [deployStep, uploadStep, prepareStep];
+    28	
+    29	  test(`only a push to ${branch} deploys, never a pull request`, () => {
+    30	    expect(workflow.on).toEqual({ push: { branches: [branch] } });
+    31	  });
+    32	
+    33	  test("WS27: the deploy key comes from its GitHub secret and reaches only the deploy, the website upload and prepareWebsiteFlag", () => {
+    34	    for (const step of keyedSteps) expect(step?.env).toEqual({ CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: `\${{ secrets.${secret} }}` });
+    35	    const elsewhere = [workflow.env, ...Object.values(workflow.jobs).map((job) => job.env), ...steps.filter((step) => !keyedSteps.includes(step))];
+    36	    expect(JSON.stringify(elsewhere)).not.toContain("secrets.");
+    37	  });
+    38	
+    39	  test("WS27: after convex deploy, the website is built against this deployment and uploaded to its static hosting", () => {
+    40	    expect(steps.indexOf(uploadStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(deployStep!));
+    41	    expect(uploadStep?.run).toBe('pnpm exec static-hosting upload --prod --build --build-command "pnpm website:build" --dist website/dist');
+    42	  });
+    43	
+    44	  test("WS2 WS27: every deploy runs prepareWebsiteFlag on this deployment once the website is uploaded", () => {
+    45	    expect(steps.indexOf(prepareStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(uploadStep!));
+    46	    expect(prepareStep?.run).toBe("pnpm exec convex run --prod website/flag:prepareWebsiteFlag");
+    47	  });
+    48	
+    49	  test("the workflow reads the repository and nothing more, and keeps no git credentials", () => {
+    50	    expect(workflow.permissions).toEqual({ contents: "read" });
+    51	    const checkout = steps.find((step) => step.uses?.startsWith("actions/checkout@"));
+    52	    expect(checkout?.with).toMatchObject({ "persist-credentials": false });
+    53	  });
+    54	
+    55	  test("the gate passes before the deploy runs", () => {
+    56	    const gate = steps.findIndex((step) => step.run === "pnpm gate");
+    57	    expect(gate).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
+    58	    expect(steps.indexOf(deployStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(gate);
+    59	  });
+    60	
+    61	  test("deploys run one at a time and a running deploy is never cancelled", () => {
+    62	    expect(workflow.concurrency).toEqual({ group: `deploy-${name}`, "cancel-in-progress": false });
+    63	  });
+    64	
+    65	  test("a run the branch has already moved past deploys nothing, so a rerun never rolls the deployment back", () => {
+    66	    const tipCheck = steps[steps.indexOf(deployStep!) - 1];
+    67	    expect(tipCheck?.run).toContain('git ls-remote origin "$GITHUB_REF"');
+    68	    for (const step of keyedSteps) expect(step?.if).toBe(`steps.${tipCheck?.id}.outputs.current == 'true'`);
+    69	  });
+    70	});

+43-
+44-## Rules
+45-
+46:Rules are numbered `WS1`–`WS28`. The `WS` prefix keeps them apart from #64's decision cards W1–W11, which this spec cites by their own names.
+47-
+48-### The site and its flag
+49-
+50-- **WS1. One website per deployment.** Each D9 deployment serves its own website at its `*.convex.site` root, built against that deployment (L-W5). Mock data is only ever published to a disposable deployment. The first slice has one page, the **home**, at `/`. Every other path renders a not-found page with a link home. The tab reads `HedgeHug · Home` and the subtitle is "Thanks a Hog" (#58).
+51-- **WS2. The `website` flag.** One flag gates the whole site. It is declared once through the flag seam (O33): key `website`, subject the workspace (the deployment's `SLACK_WORKSPACE_ID`), values `false` and `true`, safe default `false`. A missing key, a missing definition, a missing workspace key, a failed evaluation, or an unset `SLACK_WORKSPACE_ID` answers off. Because the seam's query path only finds an existing workspace key, an idempotent internal mutation `prepareWebsiteFlag` creates it through the seam's `workspaceKeyOf`, and every deploy runs it after `convex deploy`.
+52:- **WS3. Closed while off.** While `website` is off: every website read answers `closed`; the sign-in callback refuses to create or update a `users` row, so no new account appears; the shell shows the closed page (one hedgehog and one sentence from Max, V18, saying the website isn't open here yet and kudos in Slack work as always) with no sign-in button; and App Home shows no link (WS28). Switching off takes effect on the next read, so open pages turn closed reactively. The guarantee is that a session reads nothing while the flag is off: a session that already exists, one refreshed later, and one completed from a one-time code issued just before the switch all read `closed`. Convex Auth's own rows written during a handshake (`authVerifiers`, `authVerificationCodes`) are allowed; they carry no member fact.
+53-- **WS4. Where the flag is read.** `memberQuery` reads the flag first, before the session (WS11). The sign-in callback reads it before it writes a `users` row. App Home reads it before it renders the link. The flag is not an exposure: it gates a surface for the whole workspace, not a member's path, and is only read in queries and in the sign-in callback, where the member may not be known, so no `$feature_flag_called` is sent. Map #1's conductor records this reading of O36 (cross-map need 11).
+54-
+55-### Sign-in
+56-
+57-- **WS5. Sign in with Slack.** Convex Auth with the Auth.js Slack provider, `checks: ["state", "nonce"]`, scope `openid profile`, and `team` set to `SLACK_WORKSPACE_ID` (L-W1, W3, W10). The provider and the claim mapping live in the Slack adapter (`convex/slack/signIn.ts`), which hands the website module only a chat identity (L-W2). Credentials are `AUTH_SLACK_ID` and `AUTH_SLACK_SECRET`, the deployment's own Slack app (W10).
+58-- **WS6. Sign-in fails closed.** An unset `SLACK_WORKSPACE_ID`, another workspace's `team_id`, an empty team or user claim, or the flag off creates no account. So do the eight refusals of #64 §4.3: a wrong nonce, another client's token, a tampered state, a missing state cookie, login CSRF, a replayed one-time code, and a stolen code without the browser's verifier. The browser lands back on the site signed out (or closed), and a sign-in that started in this browser and came back without a session shows "Sign-in didn't finish" with a retry.
+59-- **WS7. Accounts link only by the Slack pair.** The account key is `<workspace>/<user>`, never an email. The `users` row keeps the name, given and family name and picture from the sign-in claims, refreshed on every sign-in (W8). A `users` row is a sign-in identity, never a member: membership stays in the directory.
+60-- **WS8. A person the directory doesn't know yet** signs in, the Slack adapter's `verifyMember` (users.info) is scheduled, and the page shows "Checking your membership…" until the directory answers, then turns into the home or the not-a-member page reactively (W4). `verifyMember` tries at most 3 times, waiting at least the `Retry-After` Slack asks for, and writes the directory only from a definite answer. After the last failure the person reads `unverified` ("We couldn't check your membership right now"), never a member, and signing in again schedules a fresh check.
+61-- **WS9. Sessions.** Convex Auth's defaults: a 1-hour JWT, 30 days total and 30 days of inactivity (W5). Refresh stays allowed and changes nothing that WS3, WS11 and WS14 check. Sign-out from the avatar menu ends the session at once, and every read rechecks the live session (L-W3), so a still-valid JWT after sign-out reads `signed-out`.
+--
+91-
+92-- **WS25. A strict Content Security Policy on the shell** (W5), because session tokens live in `localStorage`. It is a response header on every HTML response, never a `<meta>` policy, which can't forbid framing: the app owns the static route (WS26), so it wraps the component's handler to add the header. Scripts and styles from the site's own origin only; connections to the site and its deployment's `*.convex.cloud` (HTTPS and WebSocket); images from the site, Slack's avatar host and `res.cloudinary.com`; `frame-ancestors 'none'`. A face's colour (V19) is set through React's style property, which a style policy doesn't block, so no inline style is allowed. The shell holds no member data: every fact arrives through `getMyProfile`.
+93-- **WS26. App-owned routing** (L-W4). `convex/http.ts` registers the Slack routes, then Convex Auth's routes (`/api/auth/*` and `/.well-known/*`), then the static catch-all with an SPA fallback, last. Slack's URLs never move. Hashed assets are `immutable`, HTML revalidates, and the first slice ships no lazy chunks (hosting research #61).
+94:- **WS27. Deploy path.** Implementation tickets merge into the conductor's integration branch, never into `main`, because every push to `main` deploys production. A deploy builds the website against its own deployment and uploads it after `convex deploy`, then runs `prepareWebsiteFlag` (WS2). The sandbox `different-dog-467` goes first, from the integration branch, and its acceptance is the live Slack sign-in (W11). Production `affable-bat-254` follows only when the ship ticket merges the integration branch into `main`, dark: the `website` flag answers off there, so production shows only the closed page.
+95:- **WS28. App Home links in.** While `website` is on for the workspace and `SITE_URL` is set, App Home shows one "Open HedgeHug on the web" link to `${SITE_URL}/`. Otherwise App Home is unchanged. The link carries no identity (W9): a signed-out member signs in and lands on the home.
+96-
+97-## Implementation Decisions
+98-
+99-### Modules
+100-
+101-- **website package (new, `website/`)**: a pnpm workspace package beside `convex/` with its own `package.json` (React, Vite, Tailwind, Quill, Convex Auth's React client) and a DOM `tsconfig`. It imports `../convex/_generated/api`. `pnpm gate` runs its typecheck and tests through Vitest projects (W1).
+102-- **website module (new, `convex/website/`)**: `signedInMember`, `memberQuery`, the `createOrUpdateUser` callback, the `website` flag declaration and `prepareWebsiteFlag`, the `websiteClock` and its cron, and `getMyProfile`. Later pages add one query each here (W6).
+103:- **Slack adapter (extended, `convex/slack/`)**: the sign-in provider and claim mapping (`signIn.ts`), and `verifyMember` for a signed-in person the directory doesn't know (W4, WS8). App Home renders the link (WS28).
+104-- **Convex Auth (new, `convex/auth.ts`, `convex/auth.config.ts`)**: its tables, its routes, and its three public functions.
+105-- **Kudos engine (extended)**: `homeFacts` gains `refillsAt`, additive; App Home ignores it.
+106-- **Company profiles (new, `convex/companyProfiles/`)**: the posthog.com sync, its table, and the matcher for one member's face (WS21–WS22). Only it knows posthog.com.
+107-- **Static hosting (new component)**: `@convex-dev/static-hosting` mounted by the app's router, not at `/` by the component, behind an app-owned wrapper that adds the CSP header (WS25, L-W4).
+108-
+109-### Contracts
+110-
+111-From #64 §3, with this slice's changes.
+112-

+232-  3. **The public surface test** replacing R50 (WS10).
+233-  4. **The browser package** with Vitest and Testing Library: each state renders from a typed `MyProfile` fixture, the hero's order (gratitude and the Slack action before the allowance and counters), no received count on the profile card, the locked cards with no level or progress, the theme control and its persistence (V6), the keyboard path, and axe in light and dark (WS16–WS24).
+234-  5. **The HTTP router**: the CSP header on `/` and an SPA path, the Slack routes unchanged, and in a browser, framing the site is refused (WS25–WS26).
+235:  6. **App Home** through the existing `appHome.test.ts` seam: the link with the flag on and `SITE_URL` set, and no link otherwise (WS28).

+237:  8. **The deploy workflows** through `deploy.test.ts`: the website builds and uploads after `convex deploy`, `prepareWebsiteFlag` runs, and the deploy key reaches only those steps (WS27).
+238-- **Proof each ticket owes:** a red test before the change and green after, `pnpm gate` green (heavy runs through `~/dev/fleet/fleet heavy --`), and for any ticket that changes what the browser shows, screenshots of the running site in light and dark mode in its pull request, plus V24's manual pass. The deploy ticket adds the live sandbox sign-in (W11) and screenshots of the sandbox; the ship ticket adds production's closed page.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * CLI tool to upload static files to a Convex static-hosting component.
+ *
+ * Usage:
+ *   npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload [options]
+ *
+ * Options:
+ *   --dist <path>            Path to dist directory (default: ./dist)
+ *   --component <name>       Component instance name (default: staticHosting)
+ *   --prod                   Deploy to production deployment
+ *   --build                  Run the frontend build before uploading
+ *   --build-command <cmd>    Override the frontend build command
+ *   --spa / --no-spa         Enable or disable SPA fallback
+ *   --cdn                    Use the legacy convex-fs integration
+ *   --cdn-delete-function    App function that deletes old CDN blobs
+ *   --concurrency <n>        Parallel upload workers (default: 5)
+ *   --help                   Show help

+function showHelp() {
+    console.log(`
+Usage: npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload [options]

+Options:

+      --cdn-delete-function <name>  Legacy app function that deletes CDN blobs
+  -j, --concurrency <n>       Number of parallel uploads (default: 5)

+Examples:

+  npx @convex-dev/static-hosting upload --cdn --prod

+// Global flag for production mode
+let useProd = true;
+const MAX_ASSETS_PER_DEPLOYMENT = 1800;
+const MAX_MANIFEST_SERIALIZED_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
+// A Convex CLI function result can be truncated around 64 KiB. Signed upload
+// URLs are long enough that 250 sometimes crosses that boundary.
+const UPLOAD_URL_BATCH_SIZE = 100;
+const MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE = 256;
+const MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES = 20;
+/**
+ * Resolve the component's deployment URLs and the instance name that answered.
+ *
+ * When the caller relied on the default name we also probe the legacy 0.1.x
+ * name so a same-name migration keeps working without `--component selfHosting`
+ * on every command; landing on the legacy name prints a one-time warning. Bails
+ * the CLI if no candidate is deployed. Uploading wouldn't work either, so a
+ * fallback would only hide the real problem.
+ */
+async function fetchUrls(requested) {
+    const candidates = componentNameCandidates(requested);
+    for (const name of candidates) {
+        try {
+            const out = await convexRunAsync(name, "lib:getUrls", {}, { quiet: true });
+            const urls = JSON.parse(out);
+            if (isLegacyAutoDetected(requested, name)) {
+                console.warn(legacyComponentNameWarning(name));
+            }
+            return { urls, componentName: name };
+        }
+        catch {
+            // Try the next candidate name.
+        }
+    }
+    console.error(`Could not reach component ${candidates
+        .map((name) => `"${name}"`)
+        .join(" or ")}. Deploy the Convex backend first and ensure --component ` +
+        `matches the name in convex.config.ts.`);
+    process.exit(1);
+}
+function convexRunAsync(componentName, functionPath, args = {}, options = {}) {
+    const serializedArgs = JSON.stringify(args);
+    const argumentBytes = Buffer.byteLength(serializedArgs);
+    if (argumentBytes > MAX_CONVEX_ARGUMENT_BYTES) {
+        throw new Error("The Convex function argument is " +
+            argumentBytes +
+            " bytes, which exceeds the portable command-line limit. " +
+            "This is an internal chunking error; please report it.");
+    }
+    return runConvexAsync([
+        "run",
+        ...(componentName ? ["--component", componentName] : []),
+        functionPath,
+        serializedArgs,
+        "--typecheck=disable",
+        "--codegen=disable",
+        ...(useProd ? ["--prod"] : []),
+    ], options);
+}
+function errorMessage(error) {
+    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+}
+async function cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction) {
+    if (!cdnDeleteFunction)
+        return 0;
+    let cleaned = 0;
+    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+        const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:listPendingBlobCleanup", { limit: 250 });
+        const blobIds = JSON.parse(output);
+        if (!Array.isArray(blobIds) ||
+            !blobIds.every((blobId) => typeof blobId === "string")) {
+            throw new Error("Component returned invalid pending CDN cleanup data");
+        }
+        if (blobIds.length === 0)
+            return cleaned;
+        const deleteChunks = chunkBySerializedArgument(blobIds, (chunk) => ({
+            blobIds: chunk,
+        }));
+        for (const chunk of deleteChunks) {
+            await convexRunAsync(undefined, cdnDeleteFunction, { blobIds: chunk });
+            await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:acknowledgeBlobCleanup", {
+                blobIds: chunk,
+            });
+            cleaned += chunk.length;
+        }
+    }
+    console.warn("Warning: CDN cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+    return cleaned;
+}
+async function cleanUpAbandonedUploads(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction) {
+    let discarded = 0;
+    let deletedFiles = 0;
+    let queuedBlobIds = 0;
+    try {
+        let stagingDrained = false;
+        for (let page = 0; page < MAX_MAINTENANCE_PAGES; page++) {
+            const output = await convexRunAsync(componentName, "lib:cleanupAbandonedStaging", { limit: MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE });
+            const result = JSON.parse(output);
+            if (typeof result.discarded !== "number" ||
+                typeof result.deletedFiles !== "number" ||
+                typeof result.queuedBlobIds !== "number") {
+                throw new Error("Component returned invalid staging cleanup data");
+            }
+            discarded += result.discarded;
+            deletedFiles += result.deletedFiles;
+            queuedBlobIds += result.queuedBlobIds;
+            if (result.discarded < MAINTENANCE_PAGE_SIZE) {
+                stagingDrained = true;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!stagingDrained) {
+            console.warn("Warning: Staging cleanup reached its per-run maintenance limit; a later upload will continue it.");
+        }
+        deletedFiles += await cleanUpPendingStorage(componentName);
+        deletedFiles += await cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, undefined, "desc");
+        deletedFiles += await cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, undefined, "asc");
+        if (discarded > 0 || deletedFiles > 0 || queuedBlobIds > 0) {
+            console.log(`Recovered ${discarded} abandoned manifest record(s), removed ${deletedFiles} old unreferenced file(s), and queued ${queuedBlobIds} CDN blob(s) for cleanup.`);
+        }
+        if (cdnDeleteFunction) {
+            const cleaned = await cleanUpPendingCdnBlobs(componentName, cdnDeleteFunction);
+            if (cleaned > 0) {
+                console.log(`Cleaned up ${cleaned} pending CDN blob(s).`);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    catch (cleanupError) {
+        console.warn("Warning: Could not finish abandoned-upload maintenance: " +
+            errorMessage(cleanupError));
+    }
+}
+async function cleanUpUnreferencedStorage(componentName, before, order = "asc") {

+function convexBinPath() {
+    const packageJsonPath = requireFromCwd.resolve("convex/package.json");
+    return join(dirname(packageJsonPath), "bin", "main.js");

+function shellCommand(command) {
+    return process.platform === "win32"
+        ? { command: "cmd.exe", args: ["/d", "/s", "/c", command] }
+        : { command: "sh", args: ["-c", command] };
+}
+export function runConvex(args) {
+    return execFileSync(process.execPath, [convexBinPath(), ...args], {
+        encoding: "utf-8",
+        stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
+    }).trim();
+}
+export function runConvexAsync(args, options = {}) {
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+        execFile(process.execPath, [convexBinPath(), ...args], { encoding: "utf-8" }, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
+            if (error) {
+                // Callers that probe optional components (e.g. resolving a legacy
+                // instance name) pass quiet so an expected miss isn't logged as a
+                // failure.
+                if (!options.quiet) {
+                    console.error("Convex run failed:", stderr || stdout);
+                }
+                reject(error);
+                return;
+            }
+            resolve(stdout.trim());
+        });
+    });
+}
+export function spawnConvex(args) {
+    return spawnSync(process.execPath, [convexBinPath(), ...args], {
+        stdio: "inherit",
+    }).status;
+}
+export function spawnShell(command, env = process.env) {
+    const cmd = shellCommand(command);

+        stdio: "inherit",
+    }).status;
+}

+async function getDeploymentSelectionFromEnv(
+  ctx: Context,
+  selectionWithinProject: DeploymentSelectionWithinProject,
+  getEnv: (name: string) => string | null,
+): Promise<
+  { kind: "success"; metadata: DeploymentSelection } | { kind: "unknown" }
+> {
+  const rawDeployKey = readDeployKeyFromEnv(getEnv);
+  const deployKey = await processDeployKeyValue(ctx, rawDeployKey);
+  if (deployKey !== undefined) {
+    const deployKeyType = isPreviewDeployKey(deployKey)
+      ? "preview"
+      : isProjectKey(deployKey)
+        ? "project"
+        : "deployment";
+    switch (deployKeyType) {
+      case "preview": {
+        // `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` is set to a preview deploy key so this takes precedence over anything else.
+        // At the moment, we don't verify that there aren't other env vars that would also be used for deployment selection (e.g. `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT`)
+        return {
+          kind: "success",
+          metadata: {
+            kind: "preview",
+            previewDeployKey: deployKey,
+            selectionWithinProject,
+          },
+        };
+      }
+      case "project": {
+        // `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` is set to a project deploy key.
+        // Commands can select any deployment within the project. At the moment we don't check for other env vars (e.g. `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT`)
+        return {
+          kind: "success",
+          metadata: {
+            kind: "deploymentWithinProject",
+            targetProject: {
+              kind: "projectDeployKey",
+              projectDeployKey: deployKey,
+            },
+            selectionWithinProject,
+          },
+        };
+      }
+      case "deployment": {
+        // `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` is set to a deployment's deploy key.
+        // Deploy to this deployment -- selectors like `--prod` / `--preview-name` will be ignored.
+        // At the moment, we don't verify that there aren't other env vars that would also be used for deployment selection (e.g. `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT`)
+        const deploymentName = await deploymentNameFromAdminKeyOrCrash(
+          ctx,
+          deployKey,
+        );
+        const deploymentType = deploymentTypeFromAdminKey(deployKey);
+        // We cannot derive the deployment URL from the deploy key, because it
+        // might be a custom domain. Ask big brain for the URL.
+        const url = await bigBrainAPI({
+          ctx,
+          method: "POST",
+          path: "deployment/url_for_key",
+          data: {
+            deployKey: deployKey,
+          },
+        });
+        const slugs = await fetchTeamAndProjectForKey(ctx, deployKey);
+        return {
+          kind: "success",
+          metadata: {
+            kind: "existingDeployment",
+            deploymentToActOn: {
+              url: url,
+              adminKey: deployKey,
+              deploymentFields: {
+                deploymentName: deploymentName,
+                deploymentType: deploymentType,
+                teamSlug: slugs.team,
+                projectSlug: slugs.project,
+                reference: slugs.reference,
+                isDefault: slugs.isDefault,
+              },
+              source: "deployKey",
+            },

+    15	export type HomeOpened = { type: "app_home_opened"; user: string; tab: "home" | "messages" };
+    16	
+    17	export function isHomeTabOpened(event: { type: string }): event is HomeOpened {
+    18	  return event.type === "app_home_opened" && (event as HomeOpened).tab === "home";
+    19	}

+    21	type Opening = { workspace: string; user: string; at: number };
+    22	
+    23	export async function reportHomeOpened(ctx: MutationCtx, { workspace, user, at }: Opening): Promise<"reported" | "unknown-person"> {
+    24	  const person = await lookup(ctx, workspace, user);
+    25	  if (person === undefined) return "unknown-person";
+    26	  if (person.kind !== "member") return "reported";
+    27	  await recordUsage(ctx, { kind: "appHomeOpened", workspace, member: person.member, at });
+    28	  await xpLevelsShownTo(ctx, person.member);
+    29	  return "reported";
+    30	}

+    32	export const reportLookedUpHomeOpening = internalMutation({
+    33	  args: { workspace: v.string(), user: v.string(), at: v.number() },
+    34	  handler: async (ctx, opening) => {
+    35	    await reportHomeOpened(ctx, opening);
+    36	  },
+    37	});
+    38	
+    39	export const publishHome = observedAction({
+    40	  args: { workspace: v.string(), user: v.string(), opened: v.optional(v.boolean()), unreportedOpeningAt: v.optional(v.number()), ...attemptArgs },
+    41	  handler: async (ctx, { attempt = 1, unreportedOpeningAt, ...home }) => {
+    42	    let unreported = unreportedOpeningAt;
+    43	    await tryAtMostThreeTimes(
+    44	      attempt,
+    45	      async (attempt) => {
+    46	        const desired = await desiredHomeOf(ctx, home);
+    47	        if (desired.kind === "unavailable") return failedAttempt(attempt, desired.retryAfterMs);
+    48	        if (unreported !== undefined) {
+    49	          const at = unreported;
+    50	          await recordUsageWithoutBlocking(() => ctx.runMutation(internal.slack.appHome.reportLookedUpHomeOpening, { workspace: home.workspace, user: home.user, at }));
+    51	          unreported = undefined;
+    52	        }
+    53	        const { view } = desired;
+    54	        const retry = await sendOnce(ctx, home.workspace, "views.publish", { user_id: home.user, view }, attempt);
+    55	        if (retry === null && (await changedWhileSent(ctx, home, view))) {
+    56	          await ctx.scheduler.runAfter(0, internal.slack.appHome.publishHome, { workspace: home.workspace, user: home.user });
+    57	        }
+    58	        return retry;
+    59	      },
+    60	      (retry) =>
+    61	        ctx.scheduler.runAt(retry.at, internal.slack.appHome.publishHome, {
+    62	          ...home,
+    63	          ...(unreported !== undefined && { unreportedOpeningAt: unreported }),
+    64	          attempt: retry.attempt,
+    65	        }),
+    66	    );
+    67	  },
+    68	});

+    70	export function appHomeLink(workspace: string, label: string) {
+    71	  const query = new URLSearchParams({ team: workspace, id: appId(), tab: "home" });
+    72	  return `<slack://app?${query}|${label}>`;
+    73	}

+    75	type Home = { workspace: string; user: string; opened?: boolean };
+    76	
+    77	type Unavailable = { kind: "unavailable"; retryAfterMs?: number };
+    78	
+    79	async function desiredHomeOf(ctx: ActionCtx, home: Home): Promise<{ kind: "view"; view: SlackHomeView } | Unavailable> {
+    80	  const facts = await homeFactsOf(ctx, home);
+    81	  if (facts.kind === "unavailable") return facts;
+    82	  const shown = await ctx.runMutation(internal.feedback.homes.shownHomeOf, { workspace: home.workspace, user: home.user });
+    83	  const website = await ctx.runQuery(internal.website.link.websiteLinkOf, { workspace: home.workspace });
+    84	  return { kind: "view", view: homeView(renderHome(facts, shown, website)) };
+    85	}
+    86	
+    87	async function changedWhileSent(ctx: ActionCtx, { workspace, user }: Home, sent: SlackHomeView) {
+    88	  const desired = await desiredHomeOf(ctx, { workspace, user });
+    89	  return desired.kind === "view" && JSON.stringify(desired.view) !== JSON.stringify(sent);
+    90	}
+    91	
+    92	async function homeFactsOf(ctx: ActionCtx, { workspace, user, opened }: Home): Promise<HomeFacts | Unavailable> {
+    93	  const refreshed = opened ? await refreshUser(ctx, workspace, user) : undefined;
+    94	  const known = await ctx.runQuery(internal.engine.home.homeOf, { workspace, user });
+    95	  if (known !== null) return known;
+    96	  const lookUp = refreshed ?? (await lookUpUser(ctx, workspace, user));
+    97	  if (lookUp.kind === "failed") return { kind: "unavailable", ...(lookUp.retryAfterMs !== undefined && { retryAfterMs: lookUp.retryAfterMs }) };
+    98	  return (await ctx.runQuery(internal.engine.home.homeOf, { workspace, user })) ?? { kind: "unavailable" };
+    99	}
+   100	
+   101	type SlackHomeView = ReturnType<typeof homeView>;
+   102	
+   103	function homeView({ tabBar, title, groups }: HomeView) {
+   104	  const tabs = tabBar === undefined ? [] : [buttonsOf(tabBar)];
+   105	  const header = { type: "header", text: plainText(title) };
+   106	  const body = groups.flatMap((group, index) => [...(index > 0 ? [divider] : []), ...group.map(blockOf)]);
+   107	  return { type: "home", blocks: [...tabs, header, ...body] };
+   108	}
+   109	
+   110	const divider = { type: "divider" };
+   111	
+   112	function blockOf(line: HomeLine) {
+   113	  if (line.kind === "fields") return { type: "section", fields: line.fields.map(mrkdwn) };
+   114	  if (line.kind === "choices") return buttonsOf(line.choices);
+   115	  if (line.kind === "lines") return { type: "section", text: mrkdwn(slackTextOf(line.lines)) };
+   116	  if (line.kind === "hint") return { type: "context", elements: [mrkdwn(line.text)] };
+   117	  if (line.kind === "action") return { type: "section", text: mrkdwn(line.text), accessory: buttonOf(line.action) };
+   118	  if (line.kind === "pick-channel") return { type: "section", text: mrkdwn(line.text), accessory: channelPickerOf(line) };
+   119	  if (line.kind === "link") return { type: "section", text: mrkdwn(`<${line.url}|${line.label}>`) };
+   120	  return { type: "section", text: mrkdwn(line.text) };
+   121	}
+   122	
+   123	function buttonsOf(choices: Choice[]) {
+   124	  return { type: "actions", elements: choices.map(({ selected, ...action }) => ({ ...buttonOf(action), ...(selected && { style: "primary" }) })) };
+   125	}
+   126	
+   127	function buttonOf({ label, command }: HomeAction) {
+   128	  const action = encodeHomeAction(command);
+   129	  return { type: "button", text: plainText(label), action_id: action, value: action };
+   130	}
+   131	
+   132	function channelPickerOf({ picks, picked }: Extract<HomeLine, { kind: "pick-channel" }>) {
+   133	  return { type: "channels_select", action_id: picks, placeholder: plainText("Pick a channel"), ...(picked !== null && { initial_channel: picked }) };
+   134	}
+   135	
+   136	function mrkdwn(text: string) {
+   137	  return { type: "mrkdwn", text };
+   138	}
+   139	
+   140	function plainText(text: string) {
+   141	  return { type: "plain_text", text };
+   142	}
+   143	
+   144	function appId() {
+   145	  const id = process.env.SLACK_APP_ID;
+   146	  if (!id) throw new ReportableError("SLACK_APP_ID is not set");
+   147	  return id;
+   148	}

+-The Slack adapter, the only code that knows Slack: it verifies and acknowledges Slack's requests, normalizes posted and edited messages into countable content for the engine, keeps the directory from team_join and user_change in the order Slack sent them, with whether a member is a workspace admin or owner, and fills a person it doesn't know from users.info and, when a maintainer asks, the names it lacks from users.list, delivers the indicator as a reaction, each private reply as an ephemeral to the giver, the welcome message as a DM, a level-up DM by posting it to the member, again only while the xp-levels flag is on and the member wants DMs, and App Home as a published view of the member's selected tab when they open it, looking the person up again first while the xp-levels flag is on so their admin role is current, when they click in it, after each kudos given, for the giver and every recipient, while the xp-levels flag is on, for every admin after the announcement channel changes, and when their role or membership changes, published again when the view changed while it was sent, through one delivery path that retries the indicator until it shows and tries every other send at most 3 times, within Slack's per-method rate limits, adds the app to a channel with `/hedgehug`, or with `/kudos`, its alias once the manifest registers it, answers `/hedgehug leaderboard`, optionally followed by `week`, `month` or `all`, privately with that period's Everyone board while the `everyone-board` flag is on, and as `/hedgehug` while it is off, looking a viewer the directory doesn't know up afterwards, at most 3 times, so the board's exposure reaches them, and turns each App Home click from `/slack/interactivity`, a button or the announcement channel picker, into the platform-neutral command it carries for the one command registry, acknowledged first and then run once per click by its trigger_id, ignoring a click that names a command or a setting the registry doesn't know, such as a removed switch on an App Home published before it was removed. It reports a member's App Home opening, in the mutation that records the event's receipt or, for a person the directory doesn't know yet, once after publishing App Home looks them up, and each command's result, whether or not its reply reaches Slack, looking up a person the directory doesn't know at most 3 times, to the analytics module as usage facts. A usage fact an action records, after looking a person up or for a command, that fails to record is logged with a fixed code and changes nothing the member sees; an opening recorded in the receipt's mutation shares that transaction.
++The Slack adapter, the only code that knows Slack: it verifies and acknowledges Slack's requests, normalizes posted and edited messages into countable content for the engine, keeps the directory from team_join and user_change in the order Slack sent them, with whether a member is a workspace admin or owner, and fills a person it doesn't know from users.info and, when a maintainer asks, the names it lacks from users.list, delivers the indicator as a reaction, each private reply as an ephemeral to the giver, the welcome message as a DM, a level-up DM by posting it to the member, again only while the xp-levels flag is on and the member wants DMs, and App Home as a published view of the member's selected tab when they open it, looking the person up again first while the xp-levels flag is on so their admin role is current, when they click in it, after each kudos given, for the giver and every recipient, while the xp-levels flag is on, for every admin after the announcement channel changes, and when their role or membership changes, each tab ending with a link to the website while it is open, published again when the view changed while it was sent, through one delivery path that retries the indicator until it shows and tries every other send at most 3 times, within Slack's per-method rate limits, adds the app to a channel with `/hedgehug`, or with `/kudos`, its alias once the manifest registers it, answers `/hedgehug leaderboard`, optionally followed by `week`, `month` or `all`, privately with that period's Everyone board while the `everyone-board` flag is on, and as `/hedgehug` while it is off, looking a viewer the directory doesn't know up afterwards, at most 3 times, so the board's exposure reaches them, and turns each App Home click from `/slack/interactivity`, a button or the announcement channel picker, into the platform-neutral command it carries for the one command registry, acknowledged first and then run once per click by its trigger_id, ignoring a click that names a command or a setting the registry doesn't know, such as a removed switch on an App Home published before it was removed. It owns sign-in with Slack: the Auth.js Slack provider asks for `openid profile` in the deployment's own workspace with state and nonce, and maps Slack's claims to the chat identity the website module links by, refusing another workspace, an empty claim or an unset SLACK_WORKSPACE_ID; for a signed-in person the directory doesn't know, verifyMember asks users.info at most 3 times, waiting at least the Retry-After Slack asks for, and writes the directory only from a definite answer. It reports a member's App Home opening, in the mutation that records the event's receipt or, for a person the directory doesn't know yet, once after publishing App Home looks them up, and each command's result, whether or not its reply reaches Slack, looking up a person the directory doesn't know at most 3 times, to the analytics module as usage facts. A usage fact an action records, after looking a person up or for a command, that fails to record is logged with a fixed code and changes nothing the member sees; an opening recorded in the receipt's mutation shares that transaction.
+ 
+ ## entrances
+ - route POST /slack/events: Slack delivers an Events API request, an event callback (a message or a member opening App Home) or the URL verification challenge

+import type { HomeFacts, KudosHome } from "../engine/home";

+export type HomeView = { tabBar?: Choice[]; title: string; groups: HomeLine[][] };
+
+export type Choice = { label: string; command: Command; selected: boolean };
+
+export type HomeAction = { label: string; command: Command };
+
+export type HomeLine =
+  | { kind: "text"; text: string }
+  | { kind: "fields"; fields: string[] }
+  | { kind: "hint"; text: string }
+  | { kind: "choices"; choices: Choice[] }
+  | { kind: "lines"; lines: Line[] }
+  | { kind: "action"; text: string; action: HomeAction }
+  | { kind: "pick-channel"; text: string; picked: string | null; picks: Extract<Command, { channel: unknown }>["type"] };
