# Kudos

Peer recognition for Slack: teammates thank each other with the kudos emoji within a daily allowance, and earn XP, levels, unlockable messages and achievements; teams compete on a leaderboard. The backend runs on Convex. Slack is the first chat platform, and only its adapter knows about Slack.

This repository is public: keep customer names, customer data and usage numbers out of every file, commit, branch, issue and pull request.

## Stack

- Convex, TypeScript (strict), Vitest.
- pnpm only, never npm or yarn. `npx --no -- <bin>` runs an installed binary.

## Gate

`pnpm gate` runs the typecheck, the tests, and Coherence's spec and vocabulary checks. It is the ship-to-main gate: green locally before a pull request merges to `main`. CI runs it on every pull request, beside the Coherence workflow in fail mode.

## Coherence

Coherence guards this repository's specs, vocabulary and invariants. Its hooks (`.claude/settings.json`, `.codex/hooks.json`) bring specs, practices and findings into the session.

- Ask it before changing an area: `npx --no -- coherence query practice`, `query component <folder>`, `query status`, `query invariants <path>`.
- Record decisions, defects and practice steps in its journal (`coherence decide`, `defect`, `enact`), and commit the journal with the change.
- No spec exists yet. The first domain code writes the entry spec (`<Name>.spec.md` with its trust levels) and declares its entrances. The grammar is in `node_modules/@posthog/coherence/docs/spec.md`.

## Agent skills

### Issue tracker

Issues, specs and the Wayfinder map live in GitHub Issues for `Silthus/kudos`, through the `gh` CLI. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.

### Triage labels

The five default triage labels, each string equal to its role. See `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`.

### Domain docs

Coherence is the source of truth. The domain vocabulary is Coherence's `lexicon.json` at the root (`coherence query lexicon <term>`); there is no `GLOSSARY.md`. Architecture decisions are ADRs in `docs/adr/`, and each one is recorded by a `coherence decide` record that names its path while the ADR names the record's id. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.
// @vitest-environment node
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { parse } from "yaml";

type Step = { id?: string; name?: string; if?: string; run?: string; uses?: string; with?: Record<string, unknown>; env?: Record<string, string> };
type Job = { env?: Record<string, string>; steps: Step[] };
type Workflow = {
  on: unknown;
  env?: Record<string, string>;
  permissions: unknown;
  concurrency: { group: string; "cancel-in-progress": boolean };
  jobs: Record<string, Job>;
};

const deployments = [
  { name: "sandbox", file: "deploy-sandbox.yml", branch: "spec/core-loop", secret: "CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY_SANDBOX" },
  { name: "production", file: "deploy-production.yml", branch: "main", secret: "CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY_PRODUCTION" },
];

describe.each(deployments)("deploying the $name deployment", ({ name, file, branch, secret }) => {
  const workflow = parse(readFileSync(new URL(`./${file}`, import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Workflow;
  const steps = Object.values(workflow.jobs).flatMap((job) => job.steps);
  const deployStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("convex deploy"));
  const uploadStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("static-hosting upload"));
  const prepareStep = steps.find((step) => step.run?.includes("website/flag:prepareWebsiteFlag"));
  const keyedSteps = [deployStep, uploadStep, prepareStep];

  test(`only a push to ${branch} deploys, never a pull request`, () => {
    expect(workflow.on).toEqual({ push: { branches: [branch] } });
  });

  test("WS27: the deploy key comes from its GitHub secret and reaches only the deploy, the website upload and prepareWebsiteFlag", () => {
    for (const step of keyedSteps) expect(step?.env).toEqual({ CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: `\${{ secrets.${secret} }}` });
    const elsewhere = [workflow.env, ...Object.values(workflow.jobs).map((job) => job.env), ...steps.filter((step) => !keyedSteps.includes(step))];
    expect(JSON.stringify(elsewhere)).not.toContain("secrets.");
  });

  test("WS27: after convex deploy, the website is built against this deployment and uploaded to its static hosting", () => {
    expect(steps.indexOf(uploadStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(deployStep!));
    expect(uploadStep?.run).toBe('pnpm exec static-hosting upload --build --build-command "pnpm website:build" --dist website/dist');
  });

  test("WS2 WS27: every deploy runs prepareWebsiteFlag on this deployment once the website is uploaded", () => {
    expect(steps.indexOf(prepareStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(uploadStep!));
    expect(prepareStep?.run).toBe("pnpm exec convex run website/flag:prepareWebsiteFlag");
  });

  test("the workflow reads the repository and nothing more, and keeps no git credentials", () => {
    expect(workflow.permissions).toEqual({ contents: "read" });
    const checkout = steps.find((step) => step.uses?.startsWith("actions/checkout@"));
    expect(checkout?.with).toMatchObject({ "persist-credentials": false });
  });

  test("the gate passes before the deploy runs", () => {
    const gate = steps.findIndex((step) => step.run === "pnpm gate");
    expect(gate).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(steps.indexOf(deployStep!)).toBeGreaterThan(gate);
  });

  test("deploys run one at a time and a running deploy is never cancelled", () => {
    expect(workflow.concurrency).toEqual({ group: `deploy-${name}`, "cancel-in-progress": false });
  });

  test("a run the branch has already moved past deploys nothing, so a rerun never rolls the deployment back", () => {
    const tipCheck = steps[steps.indexOf(deployStep!) - 1];
    expect(tipCheck?.run).toContain('git ls-remote origin "$GITHUB_REF"');
    for (const step of keyedSteps) expect(step?.if).toBe(`steps.${tipCheck?.id}.outputs.current == 'true'`);
  });
});
    });
  });

describe("WS13 WS15 WS18: a member's home answer projects their own homeFacts", () => {
  beforeEach(() => switchWebsite(t, postHog, true));

  test("a member reads their own kudos left, refill, this week and in total, with where to thank someone in Slack", async () => {
    await aMember(t, ada.user);
    await aMember(t, "U_BOB");
    await aMember(t, "U_CAROL");
    await give(t, "U_BOB", ada.user, 1, new Date("2026-10-06T10:00:00Z"));
    await give(t, ada.user, "U_BOB", 2);
    await give(t, "U_CAROL", "U_BOB", 3);
    const { asSignedIn } = await aSession(t, ada);

    expect(await myProfile(asSignedIn)).toEqual({
      kind: "member",
      name: "Ada Lovelace",
      face: { kind: "slack", image: ada.image },
      kudosEmoji: "taco",
      allowance: { left: 1, base: 3, refillsAt: Date.parse("2026-10-14T00:00:00Z") },
      thisWeek: { given: 2, received: 0 },
      lifetime: { given: 2, received: 1 },
      chatUrl: "https://app.slack.com/client/T1",
    });
  });

  test("the answer is the member's homeFacts, never another member's", async () => {
    await aMember(t, ada.user);
    await aMember(t, "U_BOB");
    await give(t, "U_BOB", ada.user, 3);
    const { asSignedIn } = await aSession(t, ada);
    const facts = await t.run((ctx) => homeFacts(ctx, "T1", ada.user));

    const profile = await myProfile(asSignedIn);

    expect([facts?.kind, profile.kind]).toEqual(["member", "member"]);
    if (facts?.kind !== "member" || profile.kind !== "member") return;
    expect(profile.allowance).toEqual({ left: facts.left, base: facts.base, refillsAt: facts.refillsAt });
    expect(profile.thisWeek).toEqual({ given: facts.givenWeek, received: facts.receivedWeek });
    expect(profile.lifetime).toEqual({ given: facts.given, received: facts.received });
    expect(profile).toMatchObject({ allowance: { left: 3 }, thisWeek: { given: 0, received: 3 } });
  });

  test("the answer updates after a kudos lands", async () => {
    await aMember(t, ada.user);
    await aMember(t, "U_BOB");
    const { asSignedIn } = await aSession(t, ada);
    expect(await myProfile(asSignedIn)).toMatchObject({ allowance: { left: 3 }, thisWeek: { given: 0 } });

    await give(t, ada.user, "U_BOB", 1);

    expect(await myProfile(asSignedIn)).toMatchObject({ allowance: { left: 2 }, thisWeek: { given: 1 }, lifetime: { given: 1 } });
  });

  test("after the member's midnight and a clock tick, the answer is the new day's, without another kudos", async () => {
    await aMember(t, ada.user, "member", "T1", "Europe/Berlin");
    await aMember(t, "U_BOB");
    await give(t, ada.user, "U_BOB", 3);
    const { asSignedIn } = await aSession(t, ada, { endsIn: week });
    expect(await myProfile(asSignedIn)).toMatchObject({ allowance: { left: 0, refillsAt: Date.parse("2026-10-13T22:00:00Z") } });

    vi.setSystemTime(new Date("2026-10-13T22:05:00Z"));
    await t.mutation(internal.website.clock.tick, {});

    expect(await myProfile(asSignedIn)).toMatchObject({ allowance: { left: 3, refillsAt: Date.parse("2026-10-14T22:00:00Z") } });
  });

  test("after the week turns and a clock tick, the answer starts the new week, keeping the totals", async () => {
    await aMember(t, ada.user);
    await aMember(t, "U_BOB");
    await give(t, ada.user, "U_BOB", 2);
    const { asSignedIn } = await aSession(t, ada, { endsIn: week });
